reviewed: dedicated direct loopback connection and GET route allowlist
watchdog shuts down only retained owned socket, including Connection:close body reader
timers cancelled and response/connection closed on success and exceptions
no inherited proxy or redirect following or caller signal mutation
real slow-header and slow-chunk tests, eleven total; source and log digests verified
